## Requirements (contract)

1. **Candidate passport + discovery provenance + duplicate/lineage detection +
   hard-gated score model; seed from the researched candidate inventory
   (`docs/build/planning/2026-09-25-six-streams/data/source-candidates.csv`,
   27 rows) without approving any source.** (SIG-ACQ-001/002)
2. **Join candidates to the existing registry and the P31.12/.13 dispositions;
   prioritize improvements to already-approved sources alongside new targets.**
   Existing P31 sources are consumed/improved — never onboarded a second time.
3. **Record document/fact/derived-publication rights separately + a Part VIII
   preflight; generate review packets and precise missing questions for the
   operator.**

### Out of scope (must NOT do)

- No source rights flip, human label, gate signature, outreach, publication,
  main integration or unapproved spend.
- Consume shared schemas/functions; never fork (registry, rights records,
  dispositions).
- No rewriting landed ADR bodies / claim history / prior run evidence / the
  active plan without an appended scoped amendment.
- `ingestion_permitted` untouched; no live fetch; no `rights_decision` minted.

## Acceptance criteria → test matrix

| # | AC | Planned test |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Mirror cannot score as independent corroboration; existing P31 source cannot be onboarded twice | lineage classes `same_bytes`/`republished_document`/`derived_summary` → `independent_yield=False`, validation refuses `I>0`; a candidate linked to a P31-owned source id is classified `p31_owned` and refused onboarding; the eight P31.12/.13 ids never appear as new work |
| 2 | High usefulness cannot override unknown rights or sensitive-data rejection; municipal publication is not auto-CC0 | max-score candidate with undetermined rights → not admissible; rights `rejected` or preflight `rejected`/`prohibited_until_review` → refused regardless of score; a municipal-published artifact records a `municipal_rights_review` gate and its lanes stay `undetermined` |
| 3 | Score changes explainable from versioned inputs; output includes uncertainty + measured-vs-estimated cost | `score()` returns per-dimension contributions under a version tag; `diff_assessments(v1,v2)` explains deltas; unknown dims stay `unscored` with named unknowns; queue output carries `uncertainty` and `cost={estimated,measured:null}` |
| 4 | 27 research rows parse; every row has URL/date/review-depth/novelty; queue rows all dispositioned | `check` command + tests: every CSV row → passport; all `registry_links` resolve to real registry ids; every candidate gets a queue disposition |
| 5 | Review packets + precise missing questions | packet generation asserts the three rights lanes, Part VIII preflight, gate state, and never asserts approval; questions generated from undetermined/unknown fields |
| 6 | Verification green; ids stamped; ADR; closeout per protocol | `make check`, docs-check, check-build-memory, audit_current_state 0 errors; ADR-130 |

## Plan

- **`tasks/src/tasks/acquisition.py`** — new module owning the candidate queue:
  - `CandidatePassport` (identity, authority/publisher, jurisdiction, scope,
    expected predicates, discovery provenance: URLs, checked-at, access status,
    review depth, novelty class, search-log notes).
  - `LineageClass` (the S5 closed vocabulary: `same_bytes`,
    `republished_document`, `derived_summary`, `new_version`, `response_to`,
    `amends`, `independent_account`) + `lineage_group` (institutional
    provenance) + `independent_yield` — a mirror class or shared group can
    never count as independent corroboration.
  - Registry join: `registry_links` resolve against `connectors.registry`
    (unknown id fails); classification `p31_owned | existing_permitted |
    existing_unpermitted | net_new`; URL-level duplicate detection vs the
    registry `homepage_url`s and across candidates; dispositions join from the
    landed sources.toml state + the committed `p272`/`p293` dispositions
    artifacts.
  - `RightsAssessment` — three separate lanes (document bytes / factual
    extraction / derived-publication) each `undetermined|decided|rejected`
    + `municipal_publication_observed` (never a licence decision).
  - `PartVIIIPreflight` — SIG-PUB-002 excluded-category flags;
    `not_assessed|screening_required|prohibited_until_review|clear`.
  - Versioned score model `acq-score/1` — `3G+3R+2I+2U+T+J−2E−2A−2S`,
    ordinal 0–3 dims, unknown dims stay unscored; `explain()` per-dimension
    contributions; `diff_assessments()` over versioned input sets.
  - Hard gates: undetermined/rejected rights lanes, sensitive-content
    preflight, municipal-rights-review, duplicate/p31_owned — all independent
    of score.
  - `acq-seed/1` deterministic dimension seeding from declared CSV fields
    (documented ordinal rules; labelled assessor + evidence; `estimated`,
    never `measured`).
- **`tasks/src/tasks/data/acquisition_queue.toml`** — `acquisition-queue/1`

## Gap table

Requirement-by-requirement check against the ticket + §55.6 after the first
implementation pass; every gap found was closed in-code before verification.

| Requirement | Where | Verdict |
|---|---|---|
| ACQ-001: named gap first | `CandidatePassport.gap` (required non-empty); 27/27 seeded with dossier/need strings — **gap found in Phase 4 (field was implicit) → closed** |
| ACQ-001: search provenance + access checks | `DiscoveryProvenance` (URLs, accessed_on, verbatim `review_status`, `reviewed_scope`, `existing_registry_or_plan`) |
| ACQ-001: distinguish existing / planned P31 / mirrors / net-new | `RegistryRelation` (`p31_owned`, `existing_permitted`, `existing_unpermitted`, `duplicate`, `net_new`) + `LineageClass` + `lineage_group` |
| ACQ-001: value = dedup'd closed gaps, not claim volume | `acq-score/1` dimensions (G/R over documented dims, never a claim count); `independent_corroboration` refuses same-group/non-independent pairs |
| ACQ-002: authority, predicates, scope/time, lineage independence, extractability, refresh cost, rights basis, Part VIII preflight | passport fields + `content_window` (**gap found — added**), `U/T/E/A` dims, three rights lanes, `PartVIIIPreflight` |
| ACQ-002: rights + sensitivity as hard gates | `Gate` enum AND-ed outside score; `admissible`/`onboardable` (**gap found — `onboardable` now requires admissibility**) |
| ACQ-002: document/fact/derived lanes separately | `RightsLane` ×3, each `LaneRecord`; a `decided` lane requires a recorded reviewer disposition |
| ACQ-002: municipal ≠ auto-CC0 | `municipal_publication_observed` flag → `MUNICIPAL_RIGHTS_REVIEW` gate + non-edict question; never satisfies a lane |
| Mirror cannot corroborate / existing source not re-onboarded | `NON_INDEPENDENT_LINEAGE` + `lineage_group` + I>0 refusal + `same_source` join + normalized-URL duplicates (tests AC1) |
| Usefulness cannot override gates | gates independent of score; tests AC2 |
| Explainable versioned scores + uncertainty + measured/estimated cost | `acq-score/1` + `acq-seed/1`, `ScoreResult.contributions`, `unscored_dimensions`, `diff_assessments`, `uncertainty_for`, `CostRecord` (tests AC3) |
| Join registry + P31.12/.13 dispositions | `join_candidate` + `load_resolutions` over `p272`/`p293` artifacts; P31 links carry their recorded dispositions |
| Prioritize improvements alongside new targets | `same_source` → `existing_*` relations → `review_improvement`, ranked in the same queue (SRC-010/019/020/025) |
| Review packets + precise missing questions | `review_packet` + `missing_questions`; committed `docs/build/reports/acquisition/` |
| Every behavior tested | 43 tests; each AC + each negative case has a dedicated test |
| ADR for decisions | ADR-130 + Appendix F row + index regen |
| Deferral owned | `D-R10-SOURCES-1` annotated, stays OPEN |

Residual honest limitations (recorded, not hidden): `acq-seed/1` dimensions
are engineering estimates derived from declared CSV fields — explicitly
`measured=false`, superseded by reviewer assessments under a new version;
`target_predicates` are declared expectation slugs pending P32.12's typed
crosswalk; no measured costs exist yet (no approved run).
